Markets.title: Ashiana Housing JV buys 10-acre land in Chennai for senior living project, eyes Rs 1,100 cr revenue
Markets.summary: Ashiana Housing, in a joint venture with Arihant Foundations, acquired nearly 10 acres of land in Chennai for a senior living project. The 9-lakh-square-foot development is projected to generate Rs 1,100 crore in revenue.

Markets.summary: Indian government bonds fell as rising geopolitical tensions pushed Brent crude oil prices above $95 per barrel. Additionally, the Reserve Bank of India highlighted persistent food inflation pressures that complicate the country's economic outlook.

Markets.title: NSE among 6 stocks hitting 52-week highs; stock rallies up to 35% in a month
Markets.summary: Six BSE 100 stocks, including NSE, DLF, and Prestige Estates, reached fresh 52-week highs on Thursday. NSE led the gains with a 35% surge over the past month, followed by Prestige Estates, which rose 32%.

Markets.title: Spike in oil prices partly reverses rupee rally, forward premiums surge
Markets.summary: Rising oil prices above $96 per barrel and regional currency pressures have caused the Indian rupee to depreciate. This spike has also driven up forward premiums and increased hedging activity among importers concerned about rising import costs and inflation.

Geo-Political.title: Major Thanksgiving storm brings flooding, flight delays across US
Geo-Political.summary: Severe storms striking both U.S. coasts on Thursday disrupted Thanksgiving travel with heavy rain, flooding, and flight delays. The severe weather also left nearly one million customers without power by Thursday evening.

Geo-Political.summary: The BBC confronted Marvin Reuter, a German man who is fighting extradition to France. He faces charges of smuggling, criminal conspiracy, and involuntary manslaughter for allegedly supplying small boats to migrant gangs.

Geo-Political.summary: A diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes has capsized near Ibiza, resulting in one death. Spain's sea rescue service is currently assessing the potential environmental damage from the incident.

Data & Insights.title: South Korea raises rates to 2-year high as inflation and housing prices remain a worry
Data & Insights.summary: South Korea's central bank raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.25 percent, marking a two-year high. The increase was driven by ongoing concerns over inflation and rising housing prices in Seoul.

Data & Insights.title: UAE eyes 7-8% growth next year as IMF reverses recession forecast, projects 0.2% expansion
Data & Insights.summary: The UAE economy minister targets 7% to 8% growth next year, while the IMF projects a modest 0.2% expansion in 2026. This recovery depends heavily on the Iran war, prompting the UAE to prioritize investments in crisis-resilient industries.

Data & Insights.title: India’s Q2 GDP growth to slow marginally to 7.6%, shows Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: A Mint poll shows India's Q2 GDP growth is expected to slow marginally to 7.6%. While resilient manufacturing and services supported the economy, a deficient monsoon and uneven rural demand weighed on growth.

Data & Insights.title: India rejects US' structural excess capacity allegations as Washington links 17% tariff to trade deal, 25% otherwise
Data & Insights.summary: India has rejected US allegations of structural excess capacity, stating that no such surplus exists in any of its sectors. Meanwhile, Washington has proposed a 17% tariff if both nations reach a bilateral trade deal, and a 25% tariff otherwise.

Data & Insights.title: US proposes extra tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods, 17% after trade deal
Data & Insights.summary: The United States has proposed additional tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods, which could be reduced to 17% if a trade deal is signed. This development impacts the US market, which is India's largest export destination and accounted for over $87 billion in goods shipments through March 2026.

Data & Insights.title: RBI shifts more gold home amid geopolitical uncertainty
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has moved more of its gold reserves back into the country. Central banks are increasingly concerned about the risks of keeping sovereign assets in foreign countries amid geopolitical tensions.
